title: One-pager (Fintech): LumenMoney - Redwood Inference - Q4 2025
body:
LumenMoney - Customer One-Pager

Customer: LumenMoney
Industry segment: Fintech
Asset type: One-page success story
Published quarter: Q4 2025

Overview
LumenMoney provides consumer finance tools and helps users understand spending and saving patterns. The team wanted AI features that felt quick and dependable without building a large internal inference operations function.

Why Redwood
- Clear path from quick start to more predictable capacity
- Visibility into performance and cost drivers
- Reliable behavior under changing traffic patterns

Outcomes (high level)
- Smoother user experience during growth spikes
- Faster troubleshooting when performance drifted
- Increased confidence expanding AI features across more user flows

Internal tracking
